commonStylePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE independent production PNG asset for Rattle restaurant operations mobile app, NOT a board. Reference image 1: only its LOWER panel labelled 안 3 is the chosen style. Ignore upper 안 2 and ignore all backgrounds/captions/labels. Reference image 2 is the already generated inventory asset: use its satin material, light and render finish, NOT its box contents or subject. Maintain one coherent family: softly rounded but precise forms, opaque white and light-gray satin, cobalt #3182F6 accents with very restrained warm cream/tan or muted plant colors when appropriate, soft upper-left lighting, slightly elevated consistent three-quarter camera. Professional, friendly, calm; not a toy/game asset.
Composition: whole single subject centered on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, square canvas, about 15% clear safety margin each side, consistent roughly 70% silhouette occupancy. Only object self shading. NO floor, NO ground plane, NO cast shadow outside object, NO pedestal, NO background badge. No background scene. One main object with at most one supporting semantic element except grouped contents naturally belonging to the main object.
NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO DIGITS, NO CURRENCY, NO LABELS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARK. Abstract rules/blocks instead of writing. Avoid glass, chrome, neon, strong reflections, tiny ornaments, excessive gloss. Crisp at a 64px UI display size.

inventoryPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for Rattle restaurant operations mobile app. Create ONE inventory icon, not a board.
Reference image: use ONLY the LOWER panel labelled 안 3 as the style reference. Ignore the upper 안 2 panel. Match its refined soft satin 3D render, round but precise edges, white/light-gray objects, cobalt #3182F6 accents, muted warm paper/cardboard colors, soft top-left light, slightly elevated three-quarter camera, quiet professional friendly appearance. Do not copy any text, captions, panel background, graphic board or labels.
Subject: one warm tan open storage box containing a white jar with a blue lid, one small cream package with blue tape and one simple white carton. Large clear silhouette, restrained details as in the lower panel inventory icon.
Composition: isolated centered whole object on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, square canvas, consistent 15% clear margin on every side, subject occupies roughly 70% of canvas. Soft self shading only; NO floor, NO ground plane, NO cast shadow outside the object. No base or pedestal. Entire object fully visible.
NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO currency, NO logos, NO watermark, NO extra symbol or badge. Opaque satin material, not glass, chrome or shiny plastic. Deliver a single transparent PNG suitable for a 64px UI illustration.
